<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import json
import os

# Read the city configuration
with open('inputs/wikidata/city_config.json', 'r') as f:
    config = json.load(f)

city_name = config.get('city_name')
country_name = config.get('country_name', '')

# Build the SPARQL query
sparql_query = f"""
PREFIX wdt: <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/>

SELECT ?p625 ?name
WHERE {{
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "coordinates"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#double> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "name"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#string> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "type"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "latitude"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#double> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "longitude"^^<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#double> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "city"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "country"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> .
    ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "region"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> .
    FILTER(
        {
            # Include city name if provided
            if($city_name = "true") ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "city"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "city" .
            # Include country name if provided
            if($country_name = "true") ?p625 <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "country"^^<http://www.wikidata.org/prop/datasets/geo/> "country" .
        }
    )
}
"""

# Ensure output directory exists
os.makedirs('outputs', exist_ok=True)

# Write the SPARQL query
with open('outputs/t07_query.sparql', 'w') as f:
    f.write(sparql_query)
</solution_file>
